class: Any test fixture that types a broker tradingsymbol (or a symbol/expiry pair) from memory instead of taking it from the real instrument catalogue can pass for months while encoding a contract Zerodha does not list; the defect surfaces only when some later code checks the catalogue, and every test built on the fixture then has to change.
mechanism: W-023's partial-execution fixtures used NIFTY26OCT<strike>CE/PE symbols with the weekly 2026-10-06 expiry; the real catalogue slice lists that expiry as NIFTY26O06<strike>.. (NIFTY26OCT.. is the monthly 2026-10-27 format, e.g. NIFTY26OCTFUT). Nothing checked the catalogue until W-026's send-time sink did.

first_seen.evidence: builder: catalogue check refused NIFTY26OCT… for expiry 2026-10-06; real symbols NIFTY26O06…; fixture fixed; verifier confirmed no assertion weakened

fix: W-026 switched the execution fixtures to catalogue symbols. W-030 (2026-09-29) added tests/test_fixture_symbols.py, a guard scanning every tests/**/*.py literal against the catalogue, and corrected the 7 genuinely-wrong files it found in the originally-swept 14 (tests/orders/test_hardening.py, test_ledger_property.py, test_lifecycle.py, test_no_state_before_fill.py, test_state_not_from_orders.py; tests/execution/test_partial_input_domain.py, test_plan.py) to real NIFTY26O06<strike><CE|PE> weekly symbols. The guard's own scan (broader than the original grep) also found 6 more pre-existing instances outside this item's named scope: two deliberate attack fixtures needing only an allowlist entry (execution/test_strategy_only.py BANKNIFTY26OCT50000CE, execution/test_complete_slices.py NIFTY26O0623625CE, both intentionally-absent symbols proving a refusal path), one locked spec example needing an allowlist (engine/conftest.py + engine/test_inputs.py + scenario/scenario_fixtures.py + scenario/test_modes.py: the section-6 golden Iron Condor at the monthly 2026-10-27 expiry, for which this catalogue SLICE holds only the future, no options), one audit-log illustrative payload needing an allowlist (audit/test_log.py: REQ-064 stores raw broker payloads unchanged, no catalogue lookup), and three genuinely deferred (marketdata/test_quote.py, marketdata/test_rule_health.py, range/test_pick_lists.py -- filed as GitHub issue, see detection.deferred_issue).

detection.note: Scans every tests/**/*.py literal (full symbols and dynamic f-string heads) against tests/fixtures/instruments/instruments_slice.csv; a same-turn red-then-green self-test (test_guard_goes_red_on_the_findings_example_mutation) proves it catches the exact finding example. Does NOT yet cover marketdata/test_quote.py, marketdata/test_rule_health.py or range/test_pick_lists.py, which are explicitly allowlisted as deferred (see deferred_issue) rather than corrected -- those three remain unguarded for their specific symbols until the follow-up lands.
